references.observation: Instituto Cervantes structures grammar revision as individually chosen short explanatory modules plus self-correcting activities.
references.principle: Short grammar explanations directly linked to answerable examples.
references.application: Each of six chapters moves from a compact Russian explanation to 8 auto-checked Spanish sentences.
references.avoid: Do not copy Cervantes lesson texts, course screens or proprietary activities.

references.observation: Anki describes active recall and spaced repetition as the two pillars of efficient memorisation.
references.principle: Require recall before showing answers and reschedule weak phrases.
references.application: The 25 speech-phrase cards reveal translations only after a user action; scheduling is deterministic locally.
references.avoid: Do not claim full Anki FSRS scheduling or reproduce its deck visuals.

references.observation: The speech-practice article emphasises short spoken activities and separate speaking sessions.
references.principle: Speaking is an independent practical act, not a final text quiz.
references.application: Use a literal 30-second preparation, 90-second speech and listening/self-review flow.
references.avoid: Do not copy characters or imply AI transcription when no AI is installed.

concepts.medium: Semantic browser DOM, authored CSS mechanical switches and single master SVG icon.
concepts.composition: Desktop instrument bench with narrow nav rail and one large active stage; phone stacks blue daily module beneath headline.
concepts.interaction: Tap through self-corrected grammar drills; start a timed oral recording that transforms into a five-point review.
concepts.motion: Brief tactile displacement and a pulse on the real recording ring only.
concepts.rationale: Chosen: readable Spanish question typography and a real audio workflow suit the language lab metaphor.

concepts.medium: Large transit-map vector and colored stops.
concepts.composition: Entire weekly syllabus drawn as one horizontal metro map with seven day stops.
concepts.interaction: Jump from stop to stop and unlock carriages of exercises.
concepts.rationale: Rejected: daily navigation would dominate the practical sentence interface and look more like a travel app.

concepts.medium: Custom canvas-based broadcast tuner and spinning knobs.
concepts.composition: A wall of analogue instruments and narrow scrolling text display.
concepts.interaction: Tune to random topics by turning the dial and record microphone speech.
concepts.motion: Spring-based rotary dial response with needle inertia.
concepts.rationale: Rejected: attractive but impractical one-handed interactions on a small iPhone and poor a11y.

selection.reason: Correct balance of visibly physical speech practice and reliable phone reading/controls.

rejected.reason: Too much visual emphasis on the weekly route rather than conversation.
Fragile and slow custom canvas input for a quiz-heavy product.

tools.reason: The installation icon is an original authored SVG; all other display elements are DOM/CSS without external art dependencies.
Standard MediaRecorder and IndexedDB are feature-detected, with timer-only fallback when unsupported or denied.

assets.role: App shortcut and PocketWorks launcher identity; oscillator trace on a blue hardware display.
assets.acceptance: Legible at icon size, no ambiguous letter monogram or copied brand.
assets.integration: Referenced from app HTML, web manifest and versioned offline Service Worker cache.
assets.provenance: Original SVG authored for the app without third-party assets.

risks: Text wrapping for Spanish prompts in 320px portrait views.
Permission denial or recording API absence must not block an oral answer.
iOS safe-area and keyboard inset when reviewing a spoken answer.
comparisons: Review home and grammar screens on 390x844 and 1366x768 in Playwright.
Review record stage and 5-item self-check on phone; verify audio playback and toast on denial.
